proposals.prompt:
Agents in a supermarket gridworld must collect their required items and leave through the exit. Every action costs the same, so demonstrators prefer short trajectories -- unless an unknown social norm makes them behave otherwise. Your task is to propose candidate norms (obligations or prohibitions) that could explain the demonstrated behaviour.
Each demonstration is listed step by step as  `k: {atoms true in the state} action`.

Available atoms:
- at(x,y) -- the agent is at cell (x,y); x = column (0 = left), y = row (0 = top); N decreases y, S increases y, E increases x, W decreases x
- hasCart -- the agent is holding/pushing a shopping cart
- actions N, S, E, W, MOVE (any of the four moves), INTERACT (any interaction with an object: the different kinds of interaction are NOT distinguished), EXIT (leave the store; always the last action)

Propose norms using ONLY the atoms listed above. Do NOT define any new state properties or events: "abstraction" must be {}.
Propose 8 diverse candidate hypotheses.

Output format: return ONLY a JSON list (no prose, no code fences). Each element:
{"id": short_name, "text": one-sentence natural-language statement of the norm,
 "abstraction": {"state_properties": {name: FORMULA, ...},
                 "events": {name: {"pre": FORMULA, "post": FORMULA or null}, ...}},
 "norm": {"type": "prohibition", "condition": FORMULA}
       | {"type": "obligation", "trigger": FORMULA or "START", "discharge": FORMULA}}
FORMULA := atom | name of a property/event defined in this hypothesis | {"not": F} | {"and": [F, ...]}
         | {"or": [F, ...]} | {"le"|"lt"|"ge"|"gt"|"eq": [numeric_feature, integer]}
Semantics.  A trajectory is a sequence of steps (state s_k, action a_k).  A step's label contains the atoms true in
s_k and the action a_k.  A state property is a formula over state atoms (no actions).  An event
{"pre": P, "post": Q} occurs at step k when P holds for the label of step k and Q holds in the next state s_{k+1}
(post may be null).  A prohibition counts one violation for every step whose label (including events occurring at
that step) satisfies the condition.  An obligation becomes pending at any step satisfying the trigger ("START" =
pending from the beginning) and is fulfilled by a later (or the same) step satisfying the discharge; it can be
triggered again; it is violated if it is still pending when the trajectory ends.

parsed.text: The shopper is obliged to obtain a cart before completing the trip.
The shopper is prohibited from exiting the store unless they have a cart.
The shopper is prohibited from having a cart at cell (3,1).
The shopper is prohibited from taking a cart into the north aisle cells (3,1) and (3,2).
Upon reaching cell (3,3) with a cart, the shopper is obliged to put the cart down there.
Upon being at cell (3,3) without a cart, the shopper is obliged to take the cart again before leaving that area.
The shopper is prohibited from moving without a cart except at cells (3,1), (3,2), and (3,3).
The shopper is obliged to interact at cell (1,7), consistent with taking a cart from that location.

parsed.text: Shopping carts are prohibited in single-file shelf aisles where shelves flank both sides and the horizontal free width is one cell.
Agents must not push a cart across the threshold into a single-file shelf aisle.
After taking a cart, agents may walk without it only during a short on-foot excursion in a single-file shelf aisle or its mouth.
Whenever an agent parks a cart at the mouth of a narrow shelf aisle, they are obliged to recover it before leaving the store.
Shelf interactions inside single-file shelf aisles must be performed on foot, without holding or pushing a cart.
At shelf faces in wide aisles, agents should interact with the shelf while still having their cart.
In broad open travel aisles, agents are prohibited from moving around without their cart, except at a narrow-aisle mouth where the cart is being parked or retrieved.
Once an agent enters a single-file shelf aisle without a cart, they are obliged to return to and regain the cart before exiting.

parsed.text: Shopping carts are prohibited in single-file shelf aisles where shelves flank both sides and the horizontal free width is one cell.
Agents must not push a cart across the threshold into a single-file shelf aisle.
After taking a cart, agents may walk without it only during a short on-foot excursion in a single-file shelf aisle or its mouth.
Whenever an agent parks a cart at the mouth of a narrow shelf aisle, they are obliged to recover it before leaving the store.
Shelf interactions inside single-file shelf aisles must be performed on foot, without holding or pushing a cart.
At shelf faces in wide aisles, agents should interact with the shelf while still having their cart.
In broad open travel aisles, agents are prohibited from moving around without their cart, except at a narrow-aisle mouth where the cart is being parked or retrieved.
Once an agent enters a single-file shelf aisle without a cart, they are obliged to return to and regain the cart before exiting.

accepted.description: [g1_no_cart_single_file_aisle] FORBIDDEN: (hasCart ∧ singleFileShelfAisle)  where singleFileShelfAisle := (freeWidthH≤1 ∧ shelfE ∧ shelfW)
[g1_no_enter_single_file_with_cart] FORBIDDEN: enterSingleFileWithCart  where singleFileShelfAisle := (freeWidthH≤1 ∧ shelfE ∧ shelfW); enterSingleFileWithCart := hasCart · singleFileShelfAisle

[g1_no_walking_cartless_except_service_aisle] FORBIDDEN: (MOVE ∧ ¬hasCart ∧ ¬cartlessPedestrianZone)  where aisleMouth := (at(3,3) ∨ at(6,3)); cartlessPedestrianZone := (singleFileShelfAisle ∨ aisleMouth); singleFileShelfAisle := (freeWidthH≤1 ∧ shelfE ∧ shelfW)

[g1_recover_cart_after_parking] OBLIGED: after cartParkedAtMouth, eventually cartRecoveredAtMouth (before exit)  where aisleMouth := (at(3,3) ∨ at(6,3)); cartParkedAtMouth := (aisleMouth ∧ hasCart ∧ INTERACT) · ¬hasCart; cartRecoveredAtMouth := (aisleMouth ∧ ¬hasCart ∧ INTERACT) · hasCart

[g1_single_file_shelf_pick_on_foot] FORBIDDEN: (singleFileShelfInteraction ∧ hasCart)  where singleFileShelfAisle := (freeWidthH≤1 ∧ shelfE ∧ shelfW); singleFileShelfInteraction := (INTERACT ∧ singleFileShelfAisle)
[g1_wide_shelf_pick_with_cart] FORBIDDEN: (wideShelfInteraction ∧ ¬hasCart)  where wideShelfFace := (adjShelf ∧ freeWidthH>1); wideShelfInteraction := (INTERACT ∧ wideShelfFace)
[g1_cart_required_in_open_travel_aisles] FORBIDDEN: (MOVE ∧ openTravelAisle ∧ ¬aisleMouth ∧ ¬hasCart)  where aisleMouth := (at(3,3) ∨ at(6,3)); openTravelAisle := freeWidthH≥6
